overview.heading: Company Overview
overview.p1: Founded in 1999 in Kuwait, Salem Dwaih Al Ajmi Company (SDA) is one of the leading enterprises in general contracting, supply and installation of marble, natural stone, and granite, as well as real estate development.
overview.p2: The company was established to be a pioneering commercial and investment flagship built on the core values of quality, innovation, and professionalism. We specialize in providing integrated solutions and strategic services that meet the growing market demands while keeping pace with global best practices.
overview.p3: Our business model relies on precise financial and administrative planning, alongside building sustainable partnerships with our clients and commercial partners, maintaining total commitment to the highest standards of transparency and operational excellence. Furthermore, we continuously strive to foster a dynamic work environment that attracts and empowers top talent to navigate rapid economic and technological shifts.

visionMission.visionText: To be the leading benchmark and the most trusted, credible first choice in our sector at both the local and regional levels; elevating our products and services to unprecedented levels of quality and innovation, while achieving sustainable investment growth that enhances our market value and effectively contributes to economic and social development.
visionMission.missionText: Our unwavering commitment is to deliver genuine added value to our clients through the optimal investment in resources and human capital, applying the latest technologies and administrative systems to ensure execution precision and performance efficiency. We strive to build enduring relationships based on mutual trust, achieve the highest levels of satisfaction for all stakeholders, and uphold the utmost standards of governance, integrity, and corporate social responsibility.
